save defaults unselected; 80 Unicode code points accepted, 81 and blank title blocked
snapshot includes only selected message; consent unchecked, safe focus, modal focus containment and Escape cancel without saving
new range resets consent; repeated confirmation inserts once; history metadata leads to exact saved detail
clear confirmation defaults retain; cancel preserves body; clear removes selected record and active detail
history filter distinguishes no match from failure; retry restores metadata and destruction guide opens in place
detail read retry restores body; conflict hides stale content and requires re-read plus new confirmation
timeout keeps selection locked; explicit failed fixture requires a fresh save confirmation
guest default discards selected text on simulated login; no automatic saved record
guest opt-in carries only selected text in page memory; logged-in preview and new consent still required
simulated A/B change clears active detail and pending selection; metadata stays in its fixture account
guest history and detail hide fixture body; login returns to metadata selection
expired save hides selection and history hides rows; relogin prepares a fresh local view
local records reset on refresh; storage empty, URL only scenario keys, no business API requests during showcase walkthrough
